name: search_project
description: Search the Godot project for a substring and return file hits with line numbers. At most max_results matches (default 50), each line cut at 200 chars, because the answer costs context. When it stops early it says `truncated: true` and reports `returned` rather than a total it never finished counting.

glob.description: Optional glob filter like **/*.gd to search only GDScript files

include_addons.description: Search res://addons/ too. Default false: third-party addon source answers almost every common identifier and crowds out the project own code.

max_results.description: Stop after this many matches (default 50). The handler has always supported it; it was missing from this schema, so the unknown-argument guard rejected anyone who tried.
